cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Let's secure the date, then count chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the quote while you say yes. That way we won't lose the booking while you're reading it.
